verdict.rationale: Quo's own AI agent, Sona, is documented as answering calls when the team can't, capturing caller details, and handing the conversation to the team. The API corroborates that Sona handles calls by supporting summaries for 'calls handled by Sona.' The evidence is a single marketing statement plus an API reference, with no configuration documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on Sona setup and handoff/transfer behavior, detail on how messages are taken and delivered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human

citations.quote: Sona answers when your team can't, captures the details you need, and hands the conversation to your team when it matters.
This endpoint supports summaries for both regular calls and calls handled by Sona.
